title: The p_d_px_d window leaks REAL stimulus identity and cannot test omitted identity

claims.statement: In every omission slot, the presentation immediately preceding the omitted slot is a PHYSICALLY DIFFERENT stimulus between the X|A and X|B conditions. Therefore any decoding window that includes that presentation is decoding a real, presented stimulus, not the omitted one.
claims.receipt: Enumerated directly from OMISSION_IDENTITY_CONDITIONS (post p4-fix), 2026-08-07: p2 A=AXAB/B=BXBA -> p1 is A vs B; p3 A=AAXB/B=BBXA -> p2 is A vs B; p4 A=BBBX/B=AAAX -> p3 is B vs A. DIFFER=True in all three.

claims.statement: The predicted leak is visible in the v6 full-corpus LFP result: the p_d_px_d window (the only one containing the preceding presentation) shows the highest balanced accuracy, and does so specifically in early visual areas, exactly where a real stimulus response would live.
claims.receipt: outputs/classification/fig04_v6_lfp_2d_5win.csv, 21 sessions, 295 cells. Balanced acc for p_d_px_d: V3 0.456, V2 0.422, V1 0.419 vs that window's frontal values PFC 0.350, FEF 0.366; and vs the same areas' clean px window V3 0.343, V2 0.357, V1 0.369. Chance 0.333.
claims.note: Direction and anatomy both match the leak hypothesis. This is an observation of a coherent signature, not proof of mechanism.

claims.statement: On the clean windows, 2D flatten+PCA decoding of OMITTED identity sits marginally above chance (spikes balanced 0.38, LFP 0.364, vs 0.333) with no permutation null yet run, so no significance can be claimed.
claims.receipt: fig04_v6_{spikes,lfp}_2d_5win.csv, 21 sessions, 300/295 successful cells. Raw accuracy (0.467/0.430) is BELOW the majority-class baseline 0.452 -- pooled n_R outnumbers n_A and n_B ~1.8:1 -- so balanced accuracy is the only readable number here.
claims.blocked_on: No permutation null was run for v6 or v7. Without it, 0.38-vs-0.333 is not a claim.

issues: p_d_px_d must be excluded from, or explicitly relabeled in, any statement about OMITTED identity in both v6 and v7. It is a usable positive control, not an omission window.
The d_px and d_px_d windows begin at the delay following the preceding presentation and may still carry its offset response -- weaker version of the same leak, not yet quantified.
The 'px' window is the only one containing no differing physical stimulus at all.
falsifier: Closed when every reported omission-decoding number is labeled by whether its window contains a differing physical stimulus, and the headline claim rests only on windows that do not.
